parties.petitioner: Ram Kishan (Since Deceased) Through His LRS Etc.

summary: Land acquisition compensation appeals; two batches: Dharuhera (Section 4 notification 12.12.2008) and Malpura/Kapriwas (Section 4 notification 13.05.2010); Malpura/Kapriwas awards governed by precedent in BESCO Ltd. and M/s Habitat Estates Pvt. Ltd., enhancing compensation to Rs. 1,49,14,975/- per acre; Dharuhera acquisition: Reference Court upheld Rs. 55,71,010/- per acre; appellants argued higher market value due to proximity to developed sectors, industrial areas, HUDA development, and comparable sales; admitted sale deeds showed prior transactions at Rs.1,00,00,000/- to Rs.1,80,72,289/- per acre; High Court maintained Reference Court award; Supreme Court reviews valuation methodology, relevance of comparable sales, and development potential; delay in filing condoned; leave granted.
final_judgment: Delay condoned; leave granted; eleven Malpura/Kapriwas appeals governed by BESCO Ltd. and M/s Habitat Estates Pvt. Ltd. judgments with enhanced compensation of Rs. 1,49,14,975/- per acre without interest for delay; disposal of sixteen Dharuhera appeals deferred pending detailed consideration of valuation and comparable sales evidence.
